title: OIR hypothesis
description: A candidate explanation with a mechanism. A hypothesis with an empty predictions array cannot hold a status above `draft`, and draft hypotheses are excluded from synthesis.

statement.description: One sentence, declarative. Multi-clause hypotheses cannot be disconfirmed.

mechanism.description: The causal chain, step by step, with identifiable links. A conclusion without a mechanism generates no novel predictions.

premises.description: FACT or CLM ids the hypothesis rests on. Enables the model-revision check in workflow 06.

predictions.description: Pre-registered, before any investigation that could test them.

relation_to_others.description: Mutual exclusivity is not required and must not be manufactured. Record the actual relation.

status.description: draft = incomplete (no prediction or no mechanism) and excluded from synthesis.

survived.description: Attack surfaces this hypothesis withstood in review. Survival is a result; a surface never attacked is untested, not clean.

origin.description: Where the hypothesis came from. Documented interpretations are the lowest-value source and should not dominate the register.
